name: sentence
notes: His chain ring rolling out low (the chain he holds in a ring in his knell pose): six hand-drawn iron links in a bowed hoop 28 px tall, alternating face-on/edge-on and swapping every two frames with a 1 px rattle, thin black-crimson doom crescents behind it (his robe and cuffs), iron-on-stone sparks raked back from its foot, low dust. Low: jump it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 32; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 42; place that point on the ring's position.
